CustomField.description: This checkbox is associated to the PeopleSoft security request for 'Salesforce Marketing Cloud' described as "Access to ExactTarget Marketing Cloud". (ASU_FC_SF MK Marketing Cloud). The user will be automatically added to the ASU Marketing Cloud chatter group.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This user has been approved to have access in the Unconnected Marketing Cloud instance (also known as the legacy instance). This MC instance is not connected to Salesforce. Access only to the ASU Marketing Cloud chatter group in Salesforce.
CustomField.label: Unconnected Marketing Cloud
